description: Points a registered domain itself (example.com) at a project hosted on forkrail.com, for DNS providers that can't put a CNAME at the root: A records at forkrail.com's two fixed addresses, and optionally the _acme-challenge CNAME that lets forkrail get the domain's certificate before traffic moves. Which project serves the domain is set at forkrail, so the A records never vary.
variableDescription: %acme%: 16 lowercase hex characters naming the domain's challenge record, the first 8 bytes of sha256('forkrail-acme:' + the domain).
